outcomes: Achieve both Entry-level and Advanced-level knowledge, skills, behaviors, and abilities.

Demonstrate knowledge, skills, behaviors, and abilities needed for such practice as Entry-level & Advanced-level pharmacy technician in a variety of contemporary settings (e.g., community, hospital, home care, long-term care)
Demonstrate additional knowledge, skills, behaviors, and abilities beyond those of the Entry-level pharmacy technician, needed for such advanced practice.
Demonstrate critical thinking skills required to work as a pharmacy technician.
Demonstrate professionalism, honesty, integrity, and a sense of responsibility to care for others and the community.
Perform pharmacy functions that are legally allowed by pharmacy technicians, under the supervision of a licensed pharmacist, in a safe and ethical manner.
Work successfully as a member of a pharmacy team in a variety of pharmacy settings.
Describe current and future pharmacy technician functions and responsibilities at the Entry-level and the Advanced-level.
